# Qwen3 Deep provider notices

RayPlacement bundles `Qwen3-1.7B-Q8_0.gguf` from the official Qwen GGUF repository at revision `90862c4b9d2787eaed51d12237eafdfe7c5f6077`. The model is licensed under Apache License 2.0; see `MODEL_LICENSE`.

Inference uses the official macOS arm64 binary release of `llama.cpp` build `b10218`. Its MIT license is included at `runtime/LICENSE`.

The exact downloadable artifacts and SHA-256 checks are recorded in `scripts/fetch_vendor_assets.sh` and `SHA256SUMS`.
